data.headline: Long Treasury yields remain elevated after a small retreat
data.summary: The thirty-year yield edged down to 5.46% on November 16 after reaching 5.47% on November 13. In the November 10 Treasury bond futures report, the asset-manager net long and the leveraged-fund net short both narrowed.

bull.text: The leveraged-fund net short in Treasury bond futures narrowed from 166,257 to 149,858 contracts between November 3 and 10.

bear.text: The thirty-year yield was 20 basis points above November 9 despite the latest 1-basis-point decline. The asset-manager net long in Treasury bond futures fell from 415,379 to 394,990 contracts in the November 10 report.

watch.text: The thirty-year minus ten-year spread widened from 32 to 34 basis points between November 13 and 16, below the November 9 spread of 38 basis points. Those benchmark yields give curve context for a long-duration Treasury fund.

limitations: Treasury bond futures and constant-maturity benchmark yields differ from the bonds TLT holds. Duration, portfolio composition and the shape of the yield curve affect fund returns.
The latest yield observations are from November 16 and futures positions are from November 10. This report has no verified TLT closing price, return, options exposure or dealer gamma.
